points.name: ui.object.clear_flag
points.semantics: clear supplied bits from object flags; may trigger redraw/layout operations

points.name: ui.object.has_flag
points.semantics: returns 1 if every requested flag bit is present, else 0

points.name: ui.object.has_state
points.semantics: returns 1 if any requested state bit is present, else 0

evidence: The clear-flag implementation masks object + 44 with the complement of flags and performs associated layout/redraw work. The flag getter computes requested_bits & ~object_flags and returns 1 iff zero. The state getter tests requested_bits against the halfword at object + 48 and returns 1 iff nonzero. Their veneers and PSRAM signatures are verified from the exact AP.
relocation: For both getters the first 8 bytes end in a flags-setting instruction; the trampoline absolute jump does not modify condition flags, and execution resumes at the IT instruction. This is supported by static instruction analysis and relocation plan tests, not device execution.
scope: all calls to the respective shared entries
limitations: Results from global getters influence many system branches, and bypassing clear_flag can alter rendering, interaction and lifecycle. Shared entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence; no device validation.
